verification.note: Fresh selected scholarly argument355–360,366–368,372–384 and bibliography388 read from institutional image PDF with local OCR. Printed373 and375–376 visually collated for Laozi comparison and qualified historical-materialism objection. Bibliographic year1994 is explicit on original first-page Chinese header, not a search-engine crawl/upload date. Distinguishes Cui Shu from Cui Shi, own Gu/Hu/Qian voices, younger critics, named translation/reception and Richter’s dispute with Schneider/Levenson. Earlier sources cited here remain unread except the separately selected1931 translation. Not a complete modern Chinese historiographical survey.

verification.note: Fresh complete essay body and notes1–16 read in original Chinese. Attributes course-based formation, reciprocal research assistance and later differences; notes11–13 distinguish publishing proposal, lack of assent and surviving letters. Post1949 public criticism is situated under political coercion; no simple autonomous personal rejection inferred. Original archival letters/diary entries cited by Pan not freshly read.
